en: The Triplet of Causes of Seeing, The Triplet of the Wholesome.

Conditioned by a non-unwholesome state with root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by cultivation, there arises a wholesome state with root to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by cultivation, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a non-unwholesome state with root not to be abandoned by seeing, there arises an unwholesome state with root to be abandoned by seeing, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Six under root, nine under object, [three] under predominance...
Six... [as before] ...nine in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither-to-be-abandoned-by-seeing-nor-by-cultivation and has a root, which is indeterminate, there arises a state that is neither-to-be-abandoned-by-seeing-nor-by-cultivation and has a root, which is indeterminate, by way of the root-condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of cause-condition, there are six; in the case of predominance-condition, there are six …pe… in the case of non-disappearance-condition, there are six.
